contracts.title: Service agreements
contracts.description: Recurring service at a fixed interval. At each interval a new work order is created with customer data and a new, empty checklist. The previous report is attached as a PDF.
contracts.titlePlaceholder: E.g. Annual service on gate system
contracts.hint: The checklist is attached to each new work order, but the report is always new and empty. If the start date is today, the first work order is created immediately. If it is in the past, the next future interval is used.
contracts.missingDepartment: You must be assigned to a department to create service agreements.
contracts.empty: No service agreements registered for this customer.
contracts.deleteConfirm: Delete the service agreement "{title}"? Work orders that have already been created will remain.

units.title: Equipment / units
units.description: The machines and equipment the customer has. The units can be selected when the technician fills in a service report, and the report remembers which units were inspected.

units.deleteConfirm: Delete the unit “{model}”? Service history is kept on the reports.
